sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, dépenses des utilisateurs finaux, 2024 à 2026

2024.texte: spending on information security is projected to reach $213 billion in 2025, up from $193 billion in 2024

2025.texte: global spending on information security and risk management will climb to $213 billion this year

2026.texte: Spending is estimated to increase 12.5% in 2026 to total $240 billion.
